coverageLimits.readThisFirst: This artifact is NOT 'all six invariants verified offline'. Of the six MAIN invariants, 21 / 55 / 55 / 0 (component hex ids) are provable here; part=8 and netflag=13 are only RECONSTRUCTED (Designator-based, not componentType); pages=2 is NOT provable at all. And the source is also t53's own baseline, so using it to verify t53 is self-reference.
coverageLimits.headlineRisk: CIRCULARITY, stated first because it limits every number below: docs/evidence/current/t31-dataset.json is exactly the baseline that t53-verify-main.mjs compares the live document against. Reading it offline re-states the pinned expectation. It can prove 'the baseline file still contains these numbers and has these bytes'; it CANNOT prove 'the live canvas still equals the baseline'. Calling that an offline verification of MAIN would be self-reference, not verification.

items.why: the source records 18 pages, not 2, and no offline arithmetic turns 18 into 2. The two are the SAME metric measured at two moments: 18 is the live getAllSchematicPagesInfo() length at 2026-10-21 13:51 (18 records, 18 distinct uuids - see t31-overlap-classify.mjs L62, the same call t53 makes), while 2 is the page-table length in main-restore-verify.json at 06:06:59 (the same restore event as 21=63-42). The page count therefore grew 2 -> 18 in between (16 probe pages), and 18 is NOT a 'duplicate-record array'; an earlier phrasing to that effect was wrong and is corrected here, per r7t6. Neither figure is the live page count now.
items.note: further: page ids re-register. t31 records P1 as 03feee84..., main-restore-verify records P1 as d224f8d1..., so the P1 page objects differ by time. This is a page-ID difference, not a count-object or dedupe difference; the page-count metric is the same page-list length.

twoWeaknessesSideBySide.text: The componentType basis cannot be executed here. r7t1 has no componentType, so its 8 / 13 are reconstructions from Designator; borrowing r7t2's number would be substituting another artifact's result for a measurement, not performing one.

Even the artifact that CAN run the basis is not independent evidence: main-snapshot-r3t2.json is the pre-restore snapshot (63 components) and the 42 ids come from main-restore-verify.json, the post-restore record of the SAME restore event (21 = 63 - 42). So the componentType count and the 21 are one event's before/after, not two captures. (r7t3 established this for 21=63-42; it applies unchanged to the 8 / 13 computed on the same pair.)

componentTypeSubstitution.combinedEffect: the two weaknesses multiply instead of cancelling: the local 8 / 13 are a proxy that is not a measurement, and the one place that measures by componentType is not an independent capture. Naming r7t2 as the supporting path does NOT make part=8 / netflag=13 proven - it makes the basis traceable to a non-independent source.
componentTypeSubstitution.status: SUBSTITUTED BASIS - not a proof, in either artifact
componentTypeSubstitution.doNotQuoteAs: '8/13 verified by componentType' or '8/13 confirmed by r7t2'. The accurate sentence is: 8/13 reconstructed here from Designator, and measured by componentType only in r7t2's non-independent source pair.
